notes: Beta build 2026.08.04-673 - the auto-pilot fix your testing found: the minimum-score gate was judging shares by whether certain screens had been visited first, not by the data. A fresh session that went straight to ▶ Run scored everything 0 and bought nothing, whatever your settings. The gate now computes each share's score itself (same as the table's ⭐ column), so the bot behaves identically on beta, customer, and a fresh device. The diary also now says when scores read 0 because history has not loaded yet, so you know to let the download finish and Run again. Practice money only. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
